title: Threshold: Metroidvania Ability Gate Sound Effects
shortText: 104 metroidvania SFX: 8 ability gates, each idle, refuse, hint, unlock and open, plus abilities and map. WAV + OGG.
html:
Every ability gate, from refusal to the way through

104 metroidvania sound effects: 8 ability gates, and every one ships the same 5 stage chain, from the barrier waiting for you to the barrier gone, plus the ability that opens it.

Licence, up front

Royalty free. Commercial use. No attribution required. Use it in as many games as you like, on any platform. The one thing you may not do is resell or redistribute the sounds themselves as a sound pack. The plain language terms ship as LICENSE.txt, with a copy and paste credit line for anyone who wants one. Everything is synthesised from code, so there is no upstream sample licence behind it.

Hear it first

There is a free demo on this page: 36 sounds copied unaltered from the paid files. The energy barrier and the ice wall complete, every stage and every take, the first refusal of the other 6 gates, every ability being used, the three map reveals and the save station hum.

One chain, every gate

A metroidvania is about coming back. The player bounces off a barrier, leaves, earns an ability, and returns. Every gate here ships that whole story under the same names:

  • idle loop: the barrier waiting, a seamless 4 second loop
  • refuse: three takes, the player bouncing off it again and again
  • hint: the barrier reacting when the player returns holding the right ability
  • unlock: the ability applied
  • open: two takes, the way through

So you wire a gate once and only its element changes: energy_refuse_02, ice_refuse_02, shadow_refuse_02. Checked from the shipped files, not promised: all 8 gates carry exactly this chain, the 80 pairs of stages inside each gate all differ, and every idle loop really loops.

The gates and what opens them

  • Energy barrier, opened by the pulse beam: a humming field of current that crackles when touched.
  • Thorn vines, opened by the blade: a living wall of thorny vines that rustles and snaps back.
  • Ice wall, opened by the flame: a wall of old ice that drips, cracks and finally gives way.
  • Crystal lock, opened by the resonance: a ringing crystal seal that only the right tone breaks.
  • Spirit ward, opened by the light: an airy, whispering ward that pushes the living back.
  • Magma gate, opened by the frost: a slow river of bubbling magma that cools into rock.
  • Wind wall, opened by the heavy boots: a howling updraft that throws you back until you can stand in it.
  • Shadow veil, opened by the lantern: a dark, pulsing veil that swallows light until you bring your own.

Each opener ships twice: ability_get_<gate> when the player earns it and ability_use_<gate> when they fire it, so refusal and unlock are a pair the player learns.

The map filling in

A room, an area and a whole region revealed: three sounds, each longer than the last, measured on the shipped files (2 steps, each at least 12% longer, at least 1.5x end to end; failing steps: 0). Plus a map station download, the pause map opening and closing, and placing and removing a marker.

Upgrades, saves and travel

  • 8 upgrade sounds: health and energy upgrades, an ammo expansion and a secret found, two takes each.
  • 8 save and travel sounds: the save station hum (a loop), save confirms, entering a save room, warping out and in, and the boss door sealing behind you and unsealing.

Fit

  • WAV and OGG for every file, 16 bit, 44.1 kHz, mono, with a naming manifest listing every file by gate and stage.
  • 9 seamless loops with loop points in both formats, and none on a one shot.
  • 21 variation sets whose takes differ in length and in brightness, so the tenth bounce off a wall is not the first.
  • One loudness band: the inner 80 percent of the pack sits inside 0.65 dB, so a wind wall and a save chime share a mix.
  • Import notes for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker and the web, and pack_proof.json with a sha256 and a measurement for every file: 956 checks, 0 failed.

Honest limits

These are synthesised, stylised sounds designed for games, not field recordings. The figures above are signal measurements, not a claim that anything sounds good; that is what the free demo is for. No doors, locks or levers (those live in a separate pack), no weapons, no footsteps and nothing musical: an ability pickup is a surge of its element, never a jingle.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the code that generates these sounds was written with AI assistance. The sounds themselves are self contained procedural synthesis by Core Systems Asset Factory, with no generative audio model at any point. The cover art and store graphics are AI generated.

More from the same studio

  • Portcullis, dungeon mechanisms: the physical doors, chests, levers and traps beside your ability gates.
  • Creature Vocal Forge, twelve monsters, each with idle, alert, attack, hurt, death and a special.
  • Shatterworks, breakables: eight materials from the strain to the debris settling.
